# External examples

Pages built by an AI agent that followed `skills/nacholens/SKILL.md` alone, on public repositories that are not
related to this project. They are examples of the process, not endorsed descriptions of those projects.

Each model (`models/external/<name>.model.json`) and page quotes short identifiers and `file:line` references
from its source repository. Those parts stay under the source repository's licence, included unchanged next to
each page.

| Example | Source repository | Commits modelled | Licence |
